verified_sources.usage: bounded comparison only; not a P20 donor

p20.decision: selected-concept-seed; no original or substantive-adaptation claim

selected_elements: encDecTest and encDecTests as inspected concept evidence only

p20.retained_concept: Canonical lowercase hexadecimal encoding and value-preserving decoding are independently checkable against the wire mapping, rather than only by composing a mutually consistent encoder and decoder.
p20.source_limit: The selected artifact supplies ordinary test vectors and string/error API examples. It contains no native-fuzz exercise and does not supply learner F.Add corpus planning, fuzz invariants, or the new byte/bool API. Do not copy its vectors into starter/reference learner seeds or count this decision as a substantive adaptation.
p20.proposed_local_outcome: Learner authors a bounded native fuzz target, discriminating F.Add cases, independent canonical-wire invariants and valid-image decode value/status assertions. Instructor seeds and diagnostic probes never rescue missing learner cases or invariants.
p20.proposed_api: Encode([]byte) []byte returns lowercase ASCII hex; Decode([]byte) ([]byte, bool) is observed only on completed Encode results from the same callback. Nil and empty are equivalent byte values. The byte/bool shape is locally authored, not the selected upstream string/error signature.
assessment_scope: fuzzing.targets-seeds primary candidate and fuzzing.invariants secondary candidate, subject to later task review
Canonical wire mapping, valid-image decode status/payload and lossless roundtrip
No invalid-image rejection, uppercase-input decoder acceptance, ownership/capacity, codec implementation, or P21 crash/reproduction credit
p20.source_policy: A later task records this exact registry/commit/path/hash as concept-seed with concept-only usage. It must not use original provenance with an empty external source list. Keep concept-only lineage distinct from substantive adaptations in reports. No task id, creation record or task digest is fabricated by this source decision.
p20.rights: The file is first-party Go Authors BSD-licensed test material. Retain its exact attribution and LICENSE/PATENTS lineage in later content. Any future copied or adapted artifact requires the notices and usage classification appropriate to that artifact; this decision copies no upstream implementation, test, statement or vector.

alternatives.decision: retained as a substantive parser/crash/fix/regression donor for separate P21 selection; not a lossless hex invariant exercise
not selected: normalized record roundtrip, not arbitrary-byte lossless encoding

p20.search_limit: This is a bounded comparison and a positive concept-seed selection. It does not claim an exhaustive absence of a suitable fuzz donor.

future_assessment_gates.canonical_case: At least one learner-selected seed must produce letters a-f. The design proof uses a low byte such as0x0a so that the high-bit case remains independently necessary. A paired uppercase encoder/decoder survives roundtrip-only assertions and removal of the sole letter seed; an independent lowercase wire oracle rejects it. Do not publish the instructor proof corpus as a required learner seed list.
future_assessment_gates.oracle_alternatives: Prove readonly []byte digit-table indexing with division/remainder, plus exact standard-library encoding/hex.AppendEncode with literal nil or typed []byte(nil) destination and current Seed/SeedClone input. Its output remains OtherBytes and cannot replace a SUT-produced encoded argument. Import/function aliases and synchronous helpers retain exact signature/origin checks.
future_assessment_gates.resources: Hex doubles the byte length: the existing synthetic prefix fixture cap/proof does not establish the new8192-byte output bound. Recalculate serialization, prove maximum trace/race/native/raw-exit behavior and review before executable-profile activation.
future_assessment_gates.pipeline: Separate reviewed ADR and check-collection migration; same finite contract at task-check starter/reference/mutants and learner public/full; useful public feedback; hidden mutation adequacy uses only learner F.Add. Then separate tooling and content PRs with required gates, independent review and exact-head green validate before merge.

independent_review.authorization: Human authorized reviewer subagents for source and final PR review in the foundation goal chain.
independent_review.decision: APPROVE source-only concept/API decision and private hex extension design; content authoring remains gated on executable profile and separate activation ADR/tooling/content reviews.
independent_review.execution: Read-only source/design review; no source execution or reviewer edits.
independent_review.limits: No P20 readiness/coverage, original provenance, substantive-adaptation count, production activation or P21 assessment approval.
